canonical_facts: Rena and Maestro Arlequino voluntarily registered their marriage in the administrative house.
Maestro is part of Arlequino's registered name as a family/lineage name according to Arlequino's declaration.
They have no permanent house yet and are recorded with temporary residence in the capital.
Property regime chosen: joint family property, while personal gifts and personal belongings may remain personal.
Their existing family purse remains a practical household-budget tool, not a separation of marital property.
Neither reported any prior registered spouse or active marital obligation.
Rena signed first; Arlequino signed as 'гениальный Маэстро Арлекино'.
After the official certifying entry, Rena and Maestro Arlequino are legally husband and wife.
